row: American College of Veterinary Preventive Medicine

The American College of Veterinary Preventive Medicine (ACVPM) is an AVMA-recognized veterinary specialty organization offering board certification in preventive medicine with the option of a specialty in epidemiology. Becoming a Diplomate of the ACVPM means joining some of the most distinguished veterinary professionals in preventive medicine and public health at national and international levels.
